status: Owner-local Inventory receipt seam hardened and stock-register persisted readback qualified over real PostgreSQL, HTTP, and Next transport. The retained Commerce receipt drawer still posts the legacy Commerce command and no native Commerce purchase-fulfillment transaction exists, so inventory/feature-receipts and inventory/feature-stock-register remain partial; no authenticated browser cohort was run here.

scope.stockRegister: Current Company/branch stock, lot, count and reconciliation projection is read from Inventory-owned relations in the caller's serializable unit. The stock and Commerce order pages already opt in through ERPX_NATIVE_INVENTORY_STOCK_CONFIG; this change does not alter that rollout gate.
scope.receipts: The Inventory receipt source now excludes service order lines, and apply_stock_receipt revalidates the plain plan against the current order, warehouse, branch, order line, fulfillment line and persisted replay evidence. The seam still applies stock, lot/serial balances and quarantine evidence inside the caller's Commerce transaction; the Quality hold remains a caller-supplied StockReceiptQualityPort.
notClaimed: Initial physical-stock count create/submit/approve/post is Supply-owned and was not changed.
No native Commerce purchase-fulfillment command was implemented; packages/server-commerce/src/application/commerce.ts::fulfillOrder remains the retained writer.
No production implementation of StockReceiptQualityPort exists; only the PostgreSQL test port creates inventory_quality_holds.
No authenticated desktop/mobile browser journey was run.

behavior.source: read_stock_receipt_source selects only commerce_order_lines with item_type='stock', so a purchase service line cannot be received as stock. Company, optional branch and optional department remain caller-resolved scopes.
behavior.planValidation: validate_stock_receipt_plan rejects non-positive quantities, negative or unsafe values, duplicate line ids, missing/duplicate lot or serial identities, mismatched allocation indexes, allocation totals that differ from the line quantity or value, quarantine evidence without a reason or due date, and available allocations carrying quarantine evidence.
behavior.writeGuards: apply_stock_receipt now re-reads the order and rejects a changed Company/warehouse/branch, a receipt date before the order date, a current order version or state change, an order line whose product or item_type changed, an over-receipt against the current ordered quantity, a fulfillment line whose quantity differs from the plan, and a persisted move/allocation replay with different quantities, values, lot identities, allocation counts or quarantine disposition.
behavior.replay: A complete replay returns the persisted move and allocation quantities/values instead of echoing the caller's plan. A partial replay, a changed plan or changed lot evidence is rejected without new effects.
behavior.serviceLines: The native stock-register and receipt source projections remain Inventory-owned reads; no service-owned read was added.
